It is cleared because GAME code calls memset over a RAM range covering the player block during the level load. Which means: **an instruction-level census of store sites cannot see writes performed by a CALLEE**. Any memset/memcpy/library call that spans an address is invisible to census_address.py and census_overlays.py by construction.
